steps.npc: This is TzHaar terminal chamber, TzHaar rest here to draw warmth from the volcano.
As TzHaar grow older we lose heat and begin to solidify. Drawing heat from the volcano allows us to prolong this process.
Over time TzHaar will eventually harden and cease to be molten entirely before turning to rock, known as Haar-Tok.
In essence yes, as Haar-Tok can not move or communicate but the former TzHaar remains conscious.
